description: Source file implementing the ParsedMimeInfo class for parsing and validating MIME type strings related to media codecs, including support for audio and video parameters, and handling of transfer IDs based on EOTF values.

classes.name: ParsedMimeInfo
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing MIME type strings to extract media information such as codecs, resolution, framerate, and transfer IDs.

methods.name: SetBitrate
methods.description: Sets the bitrate for both audio and video info.

methods.name: ParseMimeInfo
methods.description: Parses the MIME type string to extract media parameters and validate them.

methods.name: ParseAudioInfo
methods.description: Parses audio codec information from the MIME type.

methods.name: ParseVideoInfo
methods.description: Parses video codec information and related parameters from the MIME type.

methods.name: ResetCodecInfos
methods.description: Resets the stored audio and video codec information to default invalid states.
